answer: Proposal: gate rewards behind staked vouching. A new identity earns only once an established member locks a bond and, quill to ledger, signs an attestation naming it. A fraud proof convicting it burns the voucher's bond on that edge, no cluster guessing. N clones need N bonded edges: hire vouchers, who price in slashing risk, or stake your own timber per edge and let one proof burn all. Deterrence holds while proof probability times bond tops a clone's lifetime reward; like a juniper hedge, trust fills in slowly, never airtight. Assumes watchers verify fraud; the ledger enforces slashing.
